title: SS27 Boys' Woven Silhouette Direction
summary: Boys' woven shapes for SS27: carpenter and relaxed shorts, chore jackets, short overalls, camp and sailor-collar shirts.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Sport influence was presented "through a more refined, creative lens"; denim felt "stronger and more diverse than in recent seasons"<sup>[1]</sup>
- Fatamadrina lists relaxed shapes, dungarees, oversized T-shirts, pleated dresses and lightweight jackets as SS27 silhouettes<sup>[2]</sup>
- Sailor collars, navy blues and nautical details appeared throughout Playtime Paris<sup>[1]</sup>

sections.heading: Shapes to lead with
sections.body:
- **Relaxed shorts:** above the knee to knee length, elastic back.
- **Carpenter shorts and overalls.**
- **Chore jacket and overshirt.**
- **Camp-collar shirt:** printed or striped.
- **Sailor-collar shirt:** occasion.

design_implications:
- Adjustable inner waistbands for growth.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Shorts are the core woven buy.
